summary: Tested tracking origin tags feature for admin contacts. All 12 backend tests passed. All 10 frontend tests passed. Features working: 1) Canal/Source filters in admin contacts tab, 2) Origin tags (QR PDF, Email, Dossier Express) visible on contact cards, 3) Origin block with Canal and Source tags visible in contact detail modal, 4) Filters correctly reduce contact list, 5) Conversion analytics still works.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/contacts correctly supports via and source query params for filtering
ContactRequest model includes tracking_via, tracking_source, tracking_campaign fields
Frontend AdminDashboard.jsx has canalFilter and sourceFilter state variables
Origin tags use amber colors for Canal (QR PDF, Email, Lien PDF) and blue for Source (Dossier Express, StrategiIA)
Contact detail modal shows origin block with data-testid='contact-origin-block' when tracking fields present
Direct contacts (without tracking) correctly show no origin tags
seed_data_creation: Created test contacts with tracking_via=qr and tracking_source=dossier_express for verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tracking origin tags feature fully tested.
